# stable_id|category|genres|premise

wd-p-0552|promise|speculative,adventure|A bridge appears only while its travelers keep a shared promise. Halfway across, the guide discovers that the promise was translated differently for the people at either end of the line.

wd-p-0553|ownership|speculative,family|A family's house follows whichever heir believes most strongly that it belongs to them. A hesitant heir's return sends it toward a place the confident relatives have spent years trying to forget.

wd-p-0554|repair|speculative,adventure|A bell-maker repairs a bell that summons lost roads. Its first ringing restores a route through the town's new reservoir, and a traveler already on the road cannot leave it without reaching its original end.

wd-p-0555|exchange|speculative,romance|Two people trade the dreams they cannot bear to have again. One begins finding comfort in a dream the other surrendered as unbearable, complicating their promise never to ask what the dreams meant.

wd-p-0556|knowledge|speculative,mystery|A librarian finds a book containing the questions its readers decided not to ask. The next blank page is addressed to her, although the person it names has been missing since before she learned to read.

wd-p-0557|resources|speculative,political|A town heats itself by burning discarded promises. A winter shortage begins when residents become more careful with their word, and the keeper of the furnace is asked to encourage harmless betrayals.

wd-p-0558|route|speculative,adventure|A ferryman can cross a river only by carrying something that belongs on the opposite bank. A stranded traveler has given away every possession, leaving the ferryman to determine what belonging means without making the traveler an object.

wd-p-0559|identity|speculative,family|A child's shadow begins resembling an estranged grandparent. The family wants it corrected before a ceremony, but the shadow is pointing toward a skill nobody else has been willing to teach the child.

wd-p-0560|threshold|speculative,mystery|A door opens only to someone who has never entered before. A detective must investigate a room while preserving the one witness whose testimony would be lost if she used her own single entry.

wd-p-0561|choice|speculative,romance|A market sells the roads not taken, allowing a buyer to visit one abandoned future. A couple buys the same future separately and discovers that only one of them appears in it.

wd-p-0562|coordination|speculative,adventure|A caravan crosses a plain where spoken directions become physical paths. Two guides disagree aloud, creating a fork that separates the supplies from the people who need them before nightfall.

wd-p-0563|status|speculative,satire|A town appoints its tallest building as ceremonial mayor. When a wealthy resident adds a tower, the old mayor's caretaker finds a forgotten clause making height depend on the public stairs actually usable by residents.

wd-p-0564|care|speculative,family|A healer can remove pain only by placing it in a familiar object. A patient asks for years of accumulated pain back after discovering that the object has become the only thing the family refuses to discard.

wd-p-0565|proof|speculative,mystery|A mirror shows what its viewer would admit under a perfectly fair question. An investigator finds that the suspect's reflection remains silent because none of the available questions grants the premise of his innocence.

wd-p-0566|inheritance|speculative,adventure|An heir receives a map that reveals safe routes only when folded incorrectly. Learning the original owner's mistakes becomes necessary to cross terrain the official family history describes as easily conquered.

wd-p-0567|recognition|speculative,romance|A person becomes visible to a town only after someone there remembers a shared experience. A visitor's partner has forgotten their first meeting, leaving a casual acquaintance as the only person who can introduce them home.

wd-p-0568|maintenance|speculative,political|A city floats because residents collectively forget its weight each night. A historian's successful campaign to remember neglected labor threatens the arrangement that has kept the city above the floodplain.

wd-p-0569|sequence|speculative,mystery|A clock records the time of a person's next honest answer. A missing witness's clock has stopped at a time already past, although several people insist they spoke with her afterward.
wd-p-0570|access|speculative,family|A family cupboard opens whenever someone is genuinely hungry. It stops opening for a child who has learned to say she is fine before anyone asks what she needs.

wd-p-0571|value|speculative,satire|A sculptor is paid in applause that can be stored and spent. The loudest commission earns almost nothing because its audience claps on command, while an unfinished work quietly supplies the rent.

wd-p-0572|territory|speculative,adventure|A forest allows passage only to travelers who name their destination honestly. A messenger carrying a sealed order must cross without knowing that the destination written on the envelope is a deliberate decoy.

wd-p-0573|permission|speculative,romance|Two lovers share a key that opens any door both want to enter. It fails at their new home, and each assumes the other's hesitation concerns the relationship rather than a secret obligation attached to the house.

wd-p-0574|interpretation|speculative,mystery|A diviner sees only the consequences of advice that will be misunderstood. The clearest vision arrives after she promises to remain silent, making the silence itself the message someone may act on.

wd-p-0575|scarcity|speculative,political|A valley's wells refill when disputes are settled fairly. A judge discovers that the water board has been prolonging small quarrels to create predictable reserves of settlements for drought season.

wd-p-0576|learning|speculative,family|A child inherits the ability to turn mistakes into useful tools. The family begins assigning difficult chores to create more tools, and the child loses the freedom to make an error without producing value.

wd-p-0577|route|speculative,adventure|A traveler purchases boots that always take the shortest route home. When they lead toward a stranger's house, she must decide whether home has changed or someone has altered what the boots know about her.

wd-p-0578|identity|speculative,mystery|A portrait ages instead of its sitter but begins showing injuries the sitter has not suffered. The painter recognizes them as repairs to a second canvas whose location the sitter refuses to disclose.

wd-p-0579|resources|speculative,family|A family grows lantern fruit that ripens when someone shares good news. During a difficult season, the youngest member starts inventing successes, producing light that fades just when people rely on it.

wd-p-0580|coordination|speculative,adventure|A fleet sails on a sea that solidifies whenever captains agree on the weather. Escaping a storm requires preserving enough disagreement to keep moving without losing the common information needed to navigate.

wd-p-0581|commitment|speculative,romance|A couple plants a tree that flowers whenever they make a joint decision. Its roots begin lifting the house because they have mistaken constant agreement for a substitute for choosing which decisions matter.

wd-p-0582|proof|speculative,political|A town's contracts write themselves in indelible ink only when all parties understand them. A lucrative agreement remains blank, and the negotiator is asked to replace the party whose unanswered questions prevent its completion.

wd-p-0583|observation|speculative,mystery|A watchtower reveals every approaching visitor except those arriving to apologize. A guard discovers repeated gaps in the log and must identify which harmless omissions allowed an unrelated intruder to pass.

wd-p-0584|repair|speculative,family|A mender can restore any broken object by using a memory of it intact. A family's cherished bowl cannot be repaired because every person remembers a different version of the meal at which it last survived.

wd-p-0585|status|speculative,satire|An academy ranks magicians by the complexity of their explanations. A practical apprentice solves a crisis with a simple method and is accused of concealing the advanced theory required to make her success respectable.

wd-p-0586|choice|speculative,adventure|A guide can open one safe passage through a mountain by closing another forever. The only unused route serves a village absent from the travelers' map, and its residents arrive while the spell is already being prepared.

wd-p-0587|inheritance|speculative,family|An heir receives a ghost whose unfinished business is to be left alone. The family expects a dramatic revelation, but every attempt to summon an explanation delays the quiet departure the ghost requested.

wd-p-0588|knowledge|speculative,mystery|A scholar discovers a dictionary in which words disappear after their last honest use. A missing word links several old testimonies, and restoring it requires someone to perform the act nobody has admitted making.

wd-p-0589|exchange|speculative,romance|A shop exchanges years of waiting for moments of perfect timing. A person spends a long separation to arrive at a reunion exactly on time, then discovers that the waiting was the experience their partner most needed understood.

wd-p-0590|maintenance|speculative,adventure|A city's protective wall repairs itself by copying the oldest intact section. A mason finds that the model section contains a narrow gate that was sealed during an unjust expulsion and is now reappearing everywhere.

wd-p-0591|access|speculative,political|A palace grants entry to anyone carrying a true grievance. Its doorkeeper learns that people who have accepted injustice as ordinary can no longer produce the proof the gate demands.

wd-p-0592|sequence|speculative,mystery|A village receives tomorrow's echoes before today's sounds. A silent morning predicts an event nobody can identify, and attempts to warn residents are producing the first echoes of the feared silence.

wd-p-0593|care|speculative,family|A caretaker can give a person one uninterrupted night of rest by staying awake in their dream. The person being helped begins planning the caretaker's dream work as though relief has no cost to anyone else.

wd-p-0594|territory|speculative,adventure|A moving border follows the person carrying a ceremonial stone. A refugee is given the stone without explanation, turning every shelter she reaches into disputed territory before she can understand why doors close behind her.

wd-p-0595|recognition|speculative,romance|A masked festival lets everyone be known only by their most generous act. Two people fall in love under identities based on the same event, each having misunderstood what the other actually gave up.

wd-p-0596|threshold|speculative,mystery|A sealed room opens when everyone who knows its secret agrees. A historian discovers that a careless retelling created one more person entitled to decide, and nobody knows how far the story has spread.

wd-p-0597|scarcity|speculative,political|A town stores courage in public lamps for emergencies. A new leader uses the reserve to make routine work feel effortless, leaving residents unable to refuse a dangerous task when the lamps finally dim.

wd-p-0598|learning|speculative,adventure|An apprentice learns a spell by retracing its inventor's failed attempts. The final failure saved someone the official instructions omit, and repeating the successful version would undo that rescue.

wd-p-0599|permission|speculative,family|A child's imaginary companion becomes visible whenever adults speak on the child's behalf. Its increasing presence delights the family until they realize that letting the child answer independently may make the companion vanish.

wd-p-0600|value|speculative,satire|A city taxes possessions according to how much their owners would miss them. A collector declares everything replaceable, and a tax inspector tests the claim by offering exact replacements with no personal history.

wd-p-0601|interpretation|speculative,mystery|A messenger hears the meaning of any sealed letter but not its words. One envelope sounds like forgiveness to its sender and accusation to its recipient, requiring the messenger to discover which unspoken event connects them.

wd-p-0602|route|speculative,adventure|A road shortens whenever travelers tell a story everyone believes. A skeptical child joins the caravan, and the guide must choose between excluding the child and finding an account honest enough to survive questions.

wd-p-0603|identity|speculative,romance|A person can borrow another's appearance but retains their own habits. A partner recognizes the disguise immediately and plays along, leaving the disguised person uncertain whether the recognition is affection or permission to remain hidden.

wd-p-0604|resources|speculative,family|A family garden grows food from shared memories of meals. After a separation, each household's garden produces only the dishes associated with the other, making ordinary nourishment depend on a conversation they have postponed.

wd-p-0605|coordination|speculative,political|A town's river changes course by majority vote. A flood threatens the smallest district, and its residents must persuade people who will never be flooded to surrender gardens that currently keep the river away.

wd-p-0606|proof|speculative,mystery|A lie detector rings only when its subject believes an answer is false. A witness's impossible account passes every test because the story has been rehearsed until the witness can no longer identify its invented parts.

wd-p-0607|repair|speculative,adventure|A bridge-builder repairs a route using stones that remember their previous positions. The restored bridge keeps leading toward an earlier river channel where travelers would now arrive beneath a newly built town.

wd-p-0608|status|speculative,family|A family measures adulthood by the first spell performed without help. A young person succeeds using a method invented jointly with a sibling and is asked to pretend the collaboration did not occur.

wd-p-0609|choice|speculative,romance|A couple may ask a wishing well one question together. They agree on the words but discover at the well that one wants reassurance while the other wants permission to change direction.

wd-p-0610|inheritance|speculative,mystery|A woman inherits a ring that grows heavier when an obligation is ignored. It becomes light after a cousin visits, although no known debt was settled and the cousin left before anyone could speak with him.

wd-p-0611|knowledge|speculative,political|A public oracle answers only questions whose answers can be acted on immediately. Officials schedule difficult questions at times when the people most affected are unable to attend, turning accurate answers into unusable knowledge.

wd-p-0612|exchange|speculative,adventure|A guide pays a toll with the memory of the way home. The travelers promise to return her, then discover that the route she forgot is the one none of their maps contains.

wd-p-0613|maintenance|speculative,family|A house's rooms remain warm while their occupants feel welcome. A family tries to solve a cold bedroom with repairs, avoiding the conversation that would reveal why its resident no longer expects to stay.

wd-p-0614|access|speculative,mystery|A gate admits people whose names appear in an ancient guestbook. A scholar finds a blank line that accepts anyone's signature, but each new entry removes the name immediately above it.

wd-p-0615|sequence|speculative,romance|Two people receive letters from each other's future selves in the wrong order. A promise of reconciliation arrives before the disagreement, making them wary of the very honesty that might prevent it.

wd-p-0616|care|speculative,political|A healer distributes a town's fatigue equally during a crisis. The policy appears fair until people whose work already requires rest begin receiving burdens measured only by how tired others feel.

wd-p-0617|territory|speculative,adventure|A cartographer's ink fixes a landscape in place. Completing a map would stop dangerous moving cliffs, but would also freeze the seasonal path by which a migrating community reaches its winter homes.

wd-p-0618|recognition|speculative,family|A child can hear the names objects were given by previous owners. A new family possession keeps using an intimate name the adults insist belongs to nobody they have known.

wd-p-0619|threshold|speculative,romance|A shared home admits each partner only after the other has thought of them that day. The rule becomes painful when ordinary distraction is interpreted as proof that affection has weakened.

wd-p-0620|scarcity|speculative,mystery|A town's candles burn longer when the truth is spoken nearby. A single candle outlasts all others in the magistrate's office, although every recorded statement made there has been exposed as false.

wd-p-0621|learning|speculative,political|An academy's entrance test requires applicants to demonstrate a spell taught only after admission. A rejected applicant succeeds by observing its practical effects, and the academy must decide whether that qualifies as learning or unauthorized access.

wd-p-0622|permission|speculative,adventure|A forest lends travelers animal forms on condition that they return before dawn. A rescuer finds a trapped traveler whose borrowed form can escape, but whose human body would be caught when the change reverses.

wd-p-0623|value|speculative,family|A family sells an enchanted table that remembers every meal. The buyer asks for its memories emptied, and the relatives discover that preserving them would require reliving the meal they all agreed never to discuss.

wd-p-0624|interpretation|speculative,political|A council consults a stone that cracks whenever a proposal is unjust. A new chair discovers that the stone responds to the proposed remedy as well as the harm, making every attempt to repair old injustice look equally forbidden.

wd-p-0625|route|speculative,romance|A staircase brings each climber to the person they most want to understand. Two partners climb together and arrive at different doors, forcing them to decide whether curiosity about someone else threatens their commitment.

wd-p-0626|identity|speculative,adventure|A traveler trades her name for safe passage, expecting to buy it back on return. The ferryman has used it to guarantee another traveler's crossing, and reclaiming it would cancel that person's protection midriver.
